common.brand.context: footer line of every page of every document

common.page.context: page number in the footer: page of pages

common.watermark.context: diagonal watermark of a sample document: the same bilingual text in both languages (stub offer or demo data)

common.notice_stub.context: footer notice while the offer of the order is a placeholder (R-25)

common.notice_demo.context: footer notice on a document built on demo data

common.pending.context: placeholder for a requisite of the sole proprietor that does not exist yet (the IP is not registered): 'after registration'

common.customer.context: label before the name of the customer

common.issued.context: label before the date the document was made

common.version.context: version number of an estimate or a report

common.sum_unit.context: unit of the sums in the heading of a column of a table

common.unknown_customer.context: customer without a name in the order

requisites.title.context: heading of the block with the account of the sole proprietor

requisites.note.context: line under the requisites: the money for purchases goes to the account of the IP only

requisites.purpose.context: label before the purpose of the payment

requisites.purpose_default.context: standard purpose of the payment when the owner has not written his own; {number} is the number of the order; 'without VAT' at the end

requisites.fee_channel.context: line under the requisites: the fee is paid by QR Xolis with a receipt, a different flow of money

quote.price_date.context: metadata label: date of the prices

quote.valid_until.context: metadata label: the estimate is valid until

quote.fx.context: metadata label: exchange rate of the Central Bank

quote.fx_value.context: exchange rate: {ccy} is the code of the currency (given by the program), {rate} the rate, {date} its date

quote.group.pc.context: heading of the group of lines: computer and parts

quote.group.mount.context: heading of the group of lines: mounting and workplace

quote.group.outside_scale.context: heading of the group of lines outside the fee scale (no fee is charged on them)

quote.group.customer_owned.context: heading of the group of lines the customer owns

quote.col.sum.context: table column: sum of the line, sums

quote.line.price_date.context: note under a line: the price is the median on the date

quote.line.vendor.context: note under a line: the seller of reference (shown only when the seller allows his name)

quote.line.confidence.high.context: note under a line: confidence of the price is high

quote.line.confidence.medium.context: note under a line: confidence of the price is medium

quote.line.confidence.low.context: note under a line: confidence of the price is low

quote.line.no_return.context: note under a line: the shop does not take the item back

quote.line.return_unknown.context: note under a line: return terms are not known yet

quote.totals.title.context: heading of the block of totals

quote.totals.components.context: row of totals: the sum the fee is counted from

quote.totals.outside.context: row of totals: lines outside the fee scale

quote.totals.reserve.context: row of totals: reserve against price growth, {rate} is the rate in percent

quote.totals.limit.context: row of totals: the limit of the purchase (money for purchases)

quote.totals.limit_note.context: note under the limit: over the limit only with written consent; the rest is returned after the report

quote.fee.title.context: heading of the block of the fee

quote.fee.base.context: column of the fee table: base of the rate

quote.fee.rate.context: column of the fee table: rate in percent

quote.fee.amount.context: column of the fee table: amount

quote.fee.rule.pc_low.context: fee rule: computer below the threshold

quote.fee.rule.pc_high.context: fee rule: computer from the threshold

quote.fee.rule.pc_high_min.context: fee rule: the minimum fee for a computer from the threshold

quote.fee.rule.mount.context: fee rule: mounting of a workplace

quote.fee.commission.context: line of the fee 1: reward for the purchase and the guarantee

quote.stages.title.context: heading of the block with the two stages of the fee

quote.total.grand.context: grand total: the limit of the purchase plus the fee

quote.nonreturn.title.context: heading of the list of lines the shop does not take back

quote.nonreturn.body.context: text over the list of non-returnable lines: separate consent is needed

quote.stamp_checked.context: word of the stamp on the estimate: the owner has checked it by hand before sending

quote.expiry.context: note at the end of the estimate: prices hold until the date

report.title.context: title of the report of the commission agent

report.basis.context: line under the title: the report is made by the offer, the content follows item 28 of the Regulation (decision of the Cabinet No. 489)

report.meta.sent.context: metadata label: date the report was sent to the customer

report.parties.contract.context: label: the contract is the order

report.parties.quote.context: label: the estimate the report refers to

report.items.title.context: section 2 of the report: the table of purchases

report.col.item.context: table column: name and serial number

report.col.shop.context: table column: shop and date of the purchase

report.col.doc.context: table column: receipt or electronic invoice

report.col.sum.context: table column: sum of the purchase

report.col.warranty.context: table column: warranty of the shop

report.item.serial.context: serial number under the name of an item

report.item.vat.context: VAT included in the price, shown when the receipt shows it

report.item.fiscal.context: kind of the document: fiscal receipt of the cash register; short, the column is narrow

report.item.esf.context: kind of the document: electronic invoice

report.item.no_receipt.context: kind of the document: there is no receipt, the customer agreed to it (consent none_with_consent); short, the column is narrow

report.item.return.context: mark of a line: return of the item to the shop (the sum is negative)

report.item.warranty_months.context: warranty of the shop in months

report.item.warranty_until.context: warranty of the shop until a date

report.item.files.context: number of attached files (receipt, ESF, warranty card, photo of the box) of a line

report.discounts.title.context: section 3 of the report: discounts and bonuses go to the customer

report.discounts.body.context: statement: every benefit of the purchase belongs to the customer

report.discounts.none.context: there were no discounts or bonuses

report.discounts.bonus.context: a bonus of a line: the item and the note

report.money.refunds.context: money row: of the spent, what the shops returned

report.money.limit.context: money row: the limit of the estimate

report.money.remainder.context: money row: the remainder to be returned to the customer

report.money.refund_due.context: note: the remainder is returned by the date

report.fee.title.context: section 5 of the report: the fee in two lines and how it was paid

report.fee.advance.context: stage of the fee paid, with the number of the receipt of Xolis

report.fee.final.context: second stage of the fee paid, with the number of the receipt of Xolis

report.fee.unpaid_advance.context: stage of the fee not paid yet

report.fee.unpaid_final.context: second stage of the fee not paid yet

report.fee.no_vat.context: note: the fee has no VAT, the sole proprietor does not pay it

report.attachments.body.context: attachments of the report: copies of receipts, invoices, warranty cards, photos of the boxes; {n} is their number

report.confirm.title.context: section 7 of the report: confirmation of the customer

report.confirm.body.context: how the customer confirms or objects; {until} is the end of the term of objections

report.confirm.body_no_date.context: the same text while the report is not sent yet and the end of the term is not known

report.confirm.accepted.context: status: the customer confirmed the report on the date

report.confirm.deemed.context: status: the report is considered accepted by the term on the date
